title: Authentication response parameter
text: The purpose of the Authentication response parameter information element is to provide the network with the authentication response calculated in the USIM
The Authentication response parameter information element is coded as shown in figure 9.9.3.4.1 and table 9.9.3.4.1
The Authentication response parameter is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 6 octets and a maximum length of 18 octets
In an EPS authentication challenge, the response calculated in the USIM (RES) is minimum 4 octets and may be up to 16 octets in length
In a 5G AKA authentication challenge, the response calculated in the ME (RES*) is 16 octets in length

fields.name: LCS indicator value
fields.description: Indicates the type of LCS request. Values: 00000000 - Normal unspecified; 00000001 - MT-LR; 00000010 to 11111111 - Normal unspecified in this version of the protocol

notes: The LCS indicator is a type 3 information element with 2 octets length
The purpose of the LCS indicator information element is to indicate that the origin of the message is due to a LCS request and the type of this request to a CS fallback capable UE

fields.name: Authentication response parameter IEI
fields.description: Information element identifier for authentication response parameter

fields.name: Length of Authentication response parameter contents
fields.description: Length of the authentication response parameter contents

fields.name: RES or RES*
fields.description: Contains the RES or RES* value (octet 3 to 18)

notes: This contains the RES or RES*.

fields.name: SMS services status IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for SMS services status

fields.name: Spare
fields.description: Bit 4 of octet 1 is spare and shall be coded as zero

fields.name: SMS services status value
fields.description: Indicates the status of availability for SMS services. Values: 000-SMS services not available, 001-SMS services not available in this PLMN, 010-Network failure, 011-Congestion. All other values are unused and shall be treated as abnormal case if received by the UE

notes: The purpose of the SMS services status information element is to indicate the status of availability for SMS services requested by the UE during the normal attach procedure or tracking area updating procedure
The SMS services status is a type 1 information element

fields.name: LCS client identity IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for LCS client identity

fields.name: Length of LCS client identity
fields.description: Length of LCS client identity value part

fields.name: LCS client identity (value part)
fields.description: The coding of the value part of the LCS client identity is given in clause 17.7.13 of 3GPP TS 29.002 [15C]

notes: The LCS client identity is a type 4 information element with a minimum length of 3 octets and a maximum length of 257 octets
The GUTI type is a type 1 information element
Bits 2 to 4 of octet 1 are spare and shall be coded as zero
